question: Does the same closed 12H V1.7 key, simultaneous on OKX and Binance for the same underlying, isolate stronger trends than one venue's key alone?
variable: On each market compare that market's original first key on jointly observable contract/clocks to the subset with an independently eligible same-name, same-direction actual V1.7 key at the exact 12H boundary on both venues. No lag or future agreement. No other variants.
common_coverage: Same base ticker spelling only; no inferred wrapper or multiplier aliases. Before selection both venues require original pre-key 90d coverage, >=10 ranked contracts, an actual H1 quote at this open and same-opening contract prices within a symmetric factor of 1.05, to reject apparent unit or identity discrepancies. Counterpart 12H data must include the exact just-closed key and complete NY Monday anchor through the key; otherwise mark as unknown rather than cross-venue disagreement. No matching for unknown ticker mapping. Each venue applies its own priority, fees and funded orders.
clock: Evaluate on the data overlap ending at 2026-09-24 00:00 UTC exclusive. OKX existing native exits at/after cutoff must be settled at the last common hour's observed close, 5bp; never drop an earlier entrant for surviving the cutoff. Controls, if triggered, use both venues' common coverage at their own clock and are attached to admitted signal parents; only the actual signal must have a simultaneous V1.7 key.
selection: Each venue has an independent 1000U unlevered nine-slot wallet, existing 2/3 resting target at 2R and 1/3 original runner. Show per-period unconditional-coverage and dual-key outcomes on BOTH venues, then matched-signal/ordinary matched non-signal and 5bp adverse market slippage on venues where the dual-key development screen passes >=100 funded trades, >=30% wins, both payoffs >=2.5 and conservative DD <=35%. The two accounts share economic signals and are not independent statistical replications. Subsequent years previously seen. Funding and market impact omitted.
